+"""Directed codebook graph-rotation auxiliary objective."""

+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Evaluate the frozen proposal; all vectors must have dimension three."""
+    if source.ndim != 2 or target.shape != source.shape:
+        raise ValueError("source and target must have matching [B, D] shapes")
+    if source.shape[-1] != 3 or codebook.ndim != 2 or codebook.shape[-1] != 3:
+        raise ValueError("directed rigid codebook graph rotation requires D=3")
+    if mask.shape != source.shape[:1]:
+        raise ValueError("mask must have shape [B]")
+    tau = float(parameters.get("temperature", 0.2))
+    eta = float(parameters.get("target_weight", 0.5))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("loss_weight", 1e-4))
+    eps = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    u = F.normalize(source, dim=-1)
+    v = F.normalize(target, dim=-1)
+    c = F.normalize(codebook, dim=-1)
+    p = torch.softmax(u @ c.T / tau, dim=-1)
+    q = torch.softmax(v @ c.T / tau, dim=-1)
+    moment = (mask.to(source.dtype)[:, None] * (p - q)[:, :, None]
+              * (u + eta * v)[:, None, :]).sum(dim=(0, 1))

+"""Directed codebook graph-rotation auxiliary objective."""

+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F

+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Evaluate the frozen proposal; all vectors must have dimension three."""
+    if source.ndim != 2 or target.shape != source.shape:
+        raise ValueError("source and target must have matching [B, D] shapes")
+    if source.shape[-1] != 3 or codebook.ndim != 2 or codebook.shape[-1] != 3:
+        raise ValueError("directed rigid codebook graph rotation requires D=3")
+    if mask.shape != source.shape[:1]:
+        raise ValueError("mask must have shape [B]")
+    tau = float(parameters.get("temperature", 0.2))
+    eta = float(parameters.get("target_weight", 0.5))
+    lam = float(parameters.get("loss_weight", 1e-4))
+    eps = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    u = F.normalize(source, dim=-1)
+    v = F.normalize(target, dim=-1)
+    c = F.normalize(codebook, dim=-1)
+    p = torch.softmax(u @ c.T / tau, dim=-1)
+    q = torch.softmax(v @ c.T / tau, dim=-1)
+    moment = (mask.to(source.dtype)[:, None] * (p - q)[:, :, None]
+              * (u + eta * v)[:, None, :]).sum(dim=(0, 1))
+    return -lam * moment.square().sum() / (mask.sum().to(source.dtype) + eps)
